title: Nonemergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) Services program reviews conducted in 2026
supports: DHS states it contracted with Myers & Stauffer to review NEMT provider claims for compliance with state and federal requirements.
DHS states provider outreach and NEMT program reviews will continue throughout 2026 and that selected providers will be contacted directly.
does_not_support: A provider selected for review is not thereby accused of fraud.
The notice does not state a questioned-cost, improper-payment, or fraud-loss amount.
The notice does not disclose the number of providers selected for review.
source_locator: MHCP provider news lines 192-197 as retrieved 2026-08-29
